entity_name: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment - EBML (مؤسسة مياه بيروت وجبل لبنان)

facts.value: Responsible for supply, distribution, and network maintenance of potable water and irrigation water for Beirut and Mount Lebanon. ALSO responsible for wastewater collection, treatment, and disposal — operates wastewater refining plants and sewage networks. Also monitors quality of potable, irrigation, and wastewater at purification plants.
facts.notes: Wastewater/sewage responsibility confirmed from ebml.gov.lb/about.php on 2026-06-01 — this was missing from previous version of the file.

facts.value: Serves approximately 2,500,000 people across 533 towns in 455,000 housing units (381,300 subscribers, 200,000 hectares). Geographic coverage: Beirut governorate + Mount Lebanon governorate including districts of Jbeil, Keserwan, Metn (Al Matn), Baabda, Aley, and Chouf. Northern boundary: Madfoun area separating Batroun and Jbeil districts. Southern boundary: Al Awwali. Does NOT cover North Lebanon (Batroun and above → NLWE), South Lebanon (→ SLWE), Bekaa (→ BWE), or Nabatiyeh (→ SLWE).
facts.notes: Coverage confirmed from ebml.gov.lb/about.php and projects.php on 2026-06-01.

facts.value: NOT responsible for private building plumbing, internal water pipes, rooftop tanks, or building pumps. Only responsible for the public supply network up to the building connection point. Sewage inside buildings is also private responsibility — BMLWE handles the public sewer network only.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-020 explicitly tests public vs private water distinction.

facts.value: Website: ebml.gov.lb. Hotline: 1713 (confirmed on site header). Working hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00AM–4:00PM, Friday 8:00AM–11:00AM. MY EBML online portal: ebml.gov.lb (for account management and service requests). Head Office: Beirut, Badaro, Sami Soloh Street, EBML Building. HQ phone: +961 1 386760/1/2. Email: info@ebml.gov.lb. Social media: visible on site. No individual phone numbers published per regional department — only addresses listed.
facts.notes: All contacts verified on ebml.gov.lb/contactus.php on 2026-06-01. Working hours confirmed. MY EBML portal confirmed in nav. Regional dept phone numbers NOT published on website.

(2) Beirut North Dept. — Beirut, Ashrafieh, Nassif Rayes Street, near Spinneys. (3) Beirut South Dept. — Beirut, Tallet el Khayat, Tamer Mallat Street, near Lebanese Television. (4) Coast of Metn Dept. — Borj Hammoud, St. Joseph Street. (5) Metn Dept. — Jdeideh, near Jdeideh Municipality. (6) Baabda Dept. — Chiah, Old Saida Road, Lamaa Street. (7) Aley Dept. — Aley, Piscine Street, Ghatrif Building. (8) Jbeil Dept. — Jbeil, Serail Jbeil. (9) Keserwan Dept. — Keserwan, Serail Jounieh.
facts.notes: All 9 department addresses confirmed from ebml.gov.lb/contactus.php on 2026-06-01. Phone numbers per department are NOT published on the website — citizens must use 1713 or visit in person.

facts.value: Official BMLWE service request taxonomy (from Forms page at ebml.gov.lb/forms.php): (1) Transfer apparatus, (2) Replace counter/meter, (3) Subscriber attestation, (4) Replace worn-out mother tube or change service source, (5) New subscription, (6) Install a box, (7) Change subscriber name, (8) Cancel subscription, (9) Increase subscription quantity, (10) Decrease subscription quantity, (11) Subscribe — building connected to network, (12) Subscribe — building not connected to network, (13) Temporary subscription. Required documents for forms: copy of subscription receipt + stamps. Note: these are administrative service requests. Infrastructure complaints (pipe burst, no water, contamination) are NOT form-based — they go through 1713 hotline only.
facts.notes: Full forms list extracted from ebml.gov.lb/forms.php on 2026-06-01. No online complaint form exists for infrastructure issues — only subscription/administrative forms.

facts.value: Two channels: (1) Call 1713 — main hotline for all infrastructure complaints (pipe burst, no water supply, water contamination, sewage overflow) and service requests. Available Mon–Thu 8AM–4PM, Fri 8AM–11AM. (2) MY EBML portal at ebml.gov.lb — online account management and service request submission. No online infrastructure complaint form exists. For CedarFix: route water complaints by GPS → correct regional department → direct citizen to call 1713. HITL required for contamination and sewage overflow complaints.
facts.notes: Confirmed on 2026-06-01: no online complaint form for infrastructure issues. 1713 is the primary complaint channel. MY EBML portal handles account/subscription matters.

facts.value: No officially published SLA. CedarFix operational targets: supply interruption 24–48h; pipe burst 24h; water contamination — immediate HITL escalation; sewage overflow — immediate HITL escalation.

primary_for_sectors: WATER_supply — no water, supply interruption, low pressure (Beirut + Mount Lebanon)
WATER_pipe — burst pipe, water leak from public network, pipe damage
WATER_contamination — discolored, smelly, or unsafe water quality
WATER_meter — faulty meter, billing dispute, meter replacement
WASTEWATER_overflow — sewage overflow, blocked public sewer, sewage smell from public network
WATER_connection — new building connection, illegal connection report
not_responsible_for: Private building plumbing or internal pipes — private contractor responsibility
Rooftop tanks, building pumps — private responsibility
Sewage inside buildings — private plumber responsibility
Water issues in North Lebanon — route to NLWE
Water issues in South Lebanon or Nabatiyeh — route to SLWE
Water issues in Bekaa — route to BWE
hitl_conditions: Water contamination reports — always HITL, potential public health emergency
Sewage overflow into streets or public spaces — HITL, public health risk
GPS falls on boundary between BMLWE and NLWE coverage area (Jbeil/Batroun border)
